subject: Execution & routing: eSign signatory verification for DPA (Globex)
body:
From: Yael Klein <yael.klein@globex.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: legal@globex.com, m.procure@globex.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final DPA: signing order & signatory confirmation

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for walking us through the latest redlines yesterday. Legal is good on the substance of the DPA, but GC wants us to confirm the signing order and that the signatories have authority to bind (our procurement team needs a stamped/dated power of attorney for their records). Can you confirm: 

- Which Redwood person should sign first (we usually have the vendor sign first).
- Whether you prefer DocuSign or Adobe Sign for countersignature.
- If you can provide a signer authority PDF for Redwood’s signee (for our procurement binder).

Goal is to get the envelope out today so our finance team can process the vendor setup and net-30 terms.

Thanks,
Yael
Yael Klein
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Globex Corporation

---

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Yael Klein <yael.klein@globex.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final DPA: signing order & signatory confirmation

Yael — thanks, glad to hear legal is aligned. Quick answers while I sync with Legal Ops: 

- Preferred sign-first: Redwood signs first so you have our fully executed PDF available immediately after countersign.
- eSign platform: we default to DocuSign but will use Adobe Sign if you have an org policy requiring it.
- Signatory: our authorized signee will be Laura Bennett (VP, Revenue Operations). I’ve looped her in.

Laura / Rishi / Karthik — please confirm you can:
1) produce a Redwood-signed authority PDF (signed, dated, title)
2) set up the DocuSign envelope with sequential routing (Redwood -> Globex Legal -> Globex Procurement)
3) confirm whether we should route for countersign (i.e., return to Redwood for final stamp) or allow immediate completion on your side.

If we get confirmation today we’ll route the envelope this afternoon.

Thanks,
Aditya
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final DPA: signing order & signatory confirmation

All — I can generate the signer authority PDF and sign it today. Operational notes: 

- We will produce a simple one-page "Signer Authority" PDF with Laura Bennett as signatory (VP, Revenue Operations), notarization optional (we have internal notary but procurement rarely requires it for vendor DPAs).
- DocuSign setup: configure envelope with routing order 1) laura_bennett@redwood.com (signer) 2) legal@globex.com (approval) 3) m.procure@globex.com (final acceptance). Add a "Recipient Attachment" field for your procurement PO if needed.
- Countersign flows: I recommend Redwood signs first, then Globex signs and the envelope completes (no return to Redwood) — this is normal for vendor DPAs and avoids double-signing. If Globex requires an internal countersign stamp after completion we'll coordinate a separate signed PDF exchange.

I'll attach the signed authority PDF and a draft envelope configuration (stubs) once done.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Signer_Authority_Form.pdf

---

From: Yael Klein <yael.klein@globex.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: m.procure@globex.com, legal@globex.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final DPA: signing order & signatory confirmation

Thanks Laura — that works. A couple of quick clarifications from procurement: 

1) Our procurement team needs a scanned letter on Redwood letterhead that shows signatory authority OR a notarized POA (either is acceptable). If you can provide the letter that’s fastest.
2) Envelope preference: Globex prefers DocuSign. Please use sequential routing and set the envelope to "require signer's phone authentication" for the Globex signing step.
3) We also need the final executed PDF for our vendor onboarding system (please cc m.procure@globex.com when the envelope completes).

If you can upload the authority letter and send the envelope by EOD Monday we’ll complete routing on our side same week.

Yael

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final DPA: signing order & signatory confirmation

Laura — attached is a one-page authority letter template I filled and Laura signed this morning. I also created the DocuSign envelope as requested: 

- Envelope ID: 1234-GLX-ENV (DocuSign)
- Routing: 1) laura_bennett@redwood.com (Sign) 2) yael.klein@globex.com (Sign with phone auth) 3) m.procure@globex.com (Receive final PDF)
- Email subject: "Redwood DPA (Globex) — Please Sign"
- Settings: sequential routing, signing order enforced, SSN/ID not requested, allow recipient attachments (procurement PO).

Attachments included: Redwood_Signer_Authority_Form.pdf (signed), DocuSign_Envelope_Link.txt (direct envelope status link).

Laura — please confirm when you click to sign (I’ll watch status and ping Globex once the envelope hits route 2).

Rishi
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Signer_Authority_Form.pdf, DocuSign_Envelope_Link.txt

From: Yael Klein <yael.klein@globex.com>

Cc: m.procure@globex.com, legal@globex.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final DPA: signing order & signatory confirmation

Rishi / Laura — received and signed. Envelope status shows "Completed" and we downloaded the final PDF to our vendor portal. Thank you for setting phone authentication — procurement confirmed the audit trail is acceptable.

DocuSign status link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/status?envelopeId=1234-GLX-ENV

Next steps for Redwood ops: please upload the fully executed PDF to the HubSpot deal and S3 vendor-binders path (cc rishi for confirmation). Procurement will issue the vendor code once that’s done.

Best,
Yael
